name: Ledger
description: Premium and modern, like a neobank: deep grounds lit by a soft glow of the brand colour, a calm grotesk with big confident figures and small change pills, white rounded cards, phone screens, icon badges and pill buttons, with generous space.

compositions.name: Gradient hero
compositions.describe: A deep page lit by a glow of the brand colour, a mark of fine rings round a brand-colour disc above; a label chip, a big white headline, a sub line and an optional button. For a short statement or a carousel cover: best at 40 characters, up to 70.

compositions.name: Trust card
compositions.describe: A pale page holding one large white card: a shield on a round badge in the brand colour, a two-tone headline (the emphasised phrase in the deep brand colour) and a sub line, with the label and the web address under the card. Use for a trust, safety or security promise of up to about 60 characters.

compositions.name: Big number
compositions.describe: A deep page with a glow of the brand colour, the label chip, one very large figure in white, a change pill (the tag) and what it counts, the sub line at the foot. With a chart of 3 to 8 points, bars or a line of the months behind the figure fill the middle. Figures of up to 8 characters.

compositions.name: Balance card
compositions.describe: A pale page with one white card like an account balance: the label, a large figure in the ink, a change pill in the brand colour (the tag) and what the figure counts; the sub line sits under the card. Use for a single number of up to 8 characters, such as an amount saved.

compositions.name: Step
compositions.describe: A white page for one step of a how-it-works carousel, centred: the step number large on a rounded tile of the brand colour, a two-tone headline and a sub line under it, the page number at the top. The figure is the step number (1, 2, 3); headline up to about 50 characters.

compositions.name: Features
compositions.describe: A white page with a two-tone headline at the top and the points on rows between fine rules, each with a tick on a round badge in the brand colour, and an optional button at the foot. Use for two to five features or reasons, each up to about 34 characters.

compositions.name: How it works
compositions.describe: A deep page lit by a glow of the brand colour: the label chip and a headline in white at the top, then the steps as rows divided by fine rules, each numbered on a round accent badge. Use for two to five steps of up to about 36 characters.

compositions.name: Testimonial
compositions.describe: A white page: a large opening quotation mark in the brand colour, the quotation in calm medium type, and at the foot round pictures from the row of pictures beside the name and the label. Use for a quotation of up to about 150 characters.

compositions.name: Phone
compositions.describe: A deep page with a glow of the brand colour: the picture as a phone screen on the right (a pre-framed phone capture, about 660 by 1354), the label chip, a white headline, a sub line and an optional button on the left. Headline up to 44 characters.

compositions.name: Photo card
compositions.describe: A white page with the picture in a large rounded window at the top and the tag on a white pill on it, then a two-tone headline, a sub line and an optional button below, left aligned. Use for a photograph with a headline of up to about 56 characters.

compositions.name: Live session
compositions.describe: A white page: the label chip, a two-tone headline, the date, time and place on ruled rows each with a calendar, clock or pin icon, and an optional button. Use for an event of up to about 50 characters of headline with a meta line like 12 Dec, 6pm, Online.

compositions.name: Gradient offer
compositions.describe: A deep page lit by a glow of the brand colour, the mark of rings above; at the foot a white headline, the offer (the tag) set very large under it, a sub line and an accent button. Use for a deal or plan with a short tag such as 0 fees or 3 months free.
